spec_evidence.checked: Official plaid-node CHANGELOG.md 43.0.0 breaking list verified: /cra/check_report/verification/pdf/get replaces the report_requested field with a reports_requested array; protect_results was removed from LinkSessionResults (API no longer populates it, so reads were already dead); Recaptcha_RequiredError.http_code changed string to integer but the API already returned an integer (spec-only correction, no runtime change); /item/handle_fraud_report was removed but was never wired up for any customer.

fix.migration_guide: The only edit that affects running integrations is the /cra/check_report/verification/pdf/get request field: rename report_requested to reports_requested and wrap the scalar value in an array. This is a deterministic key rename plus array-wrap at each call site. Reads of link session protect_results can optionally be deleted as dead code (the API stopped populating the field), but that is hygiene, not a break. The removed fraud-report endpoint had no customers, so no consumer migration exists for it.
